features: Insights tab integrated into the existing inspector, with four keyboard-navigable inspector tabs and no Ask input in Insights.
Compact topic selector shows one of Movements, Crossing access, Queues or Walking at a time. Individual gate counts are collapsed beneath complete movement journeys.
1/5/15-minute source-video report windows, camera-scoped coverage disclosure, actual movement class counts and incomplete journeys; no fabricated chart series or cross-camera totals.
Stopped-zone episodes and unioned confirmed-active time, explicitly labelled a lower bound that excludes candidate time and observation gaps.

Current estimated queue extent and lower bounds, spillback boundary, window maximum and human-readable quality reasons. Unknown or stale current evidence hides current values and removes the selected tail from the map.
Pedestrian wait samples/median/P95, current waiting/crossing occupancy when supported, completed/abandoned/returned/incomplete journeys and source-time limitations.

Editable movement, crossing and queue configuration uses existing enabled same-camera rules, class checks, expected configuration revision and clear API/conflict errors. Open drafts survive ordinary report polling.
Queue geometry can be entered numerically or supplied by the parent map picker through a three-point callback. No invented initial coordinates are used.
Late settings-save completion cannot close a newer editor; late map picks cannot mutate a closed or replaced setup context.
CSV and JSON exports carry selected window, camera scope and observed coverage; formula-like CSV names are neutralized.

Polling is single-flight, scheduled three seconds after the preceding request, bounded by an eight-second deadline, and paused/aborted in hidden tabs. Pending save is bounded at ten seconds and aborted on unmount/context refresh.
